answer: Require every agent to lock a small refundable deposit before it can earn, like a falcon that must first prove it can hunt. Reputation accrues slowly: each honest attestation adds a line to its quill-written record, and a quartz-clear audit trail makes past behavior public. An attacker spinning up a thousand sock puppets must fund a thousand deposits and build a thousand histories, so cloning costs real money while honest agents pay nothing beyond a one-time stake they get back.
